config.label: Agent wallet private key (0x…)
config.description: Agent wallet private key (0x…). Fund with USDC on Base mainnet or Sepolia. Without it the server starts read-only: the free tools still work.

config.label: CAIP-2 network id
config.description: CAIP-2 network id. Default eip155:8453 (Base mainnet); use eip155:84532 for Sepolia.

config.label: cron402 API base URL
config.description: cron402 API base URL. Defaults to the production Worker.

config.label: Directory where created job ids are remembered so list_crons can recover them
config.description: Directory where created job ids are remembered so list_crons can recover them. Defaults to ~/.cron402.
